kiel-baltic-quiet-villages-loop.title: Kiel · Baltic Quiet Villages Loop
kiel-baltic-quiet-villages-loop.slogan: A 148 km loop out of Schönkirchen exit
kiel-baltic-quiet-villages-loop.story: Low drama, high usability: tiny roads, sea air and a clear food anchor. The best part sits around Schönkirchen exit, Schönberg coast, Plön lakes, while Lütjenburg food keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

scenicChapters.title: Schönberg coast → Lütjenburg food
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 37 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
